description: LIMITATION PIN (not a merge defect). A labelled `break outer;` escaping two loop levels, with A editing the inner accumulator and B an independent variable. The merge is clean and the affected points are right; emission fails twice over - the label declaration `outer:` is not a vertex at all so it is dropped, and `break outer;` does not match the bare-jump test in reconstitute.is_jump, so it is rendered as a block header. Fixing the second alone would not help while the label is missing. Same family as switch/for/do-while. Pinned; XPASS retires it.
expect_fail: labelled break: the label is not exported and the jump renders as a block header
category: known limitation (labelled jumps are not emittable)
